topic: What Steve Jobs Really Thought About Bill Gates

youtube.title: What Steve Jobs Really Thought About Bill Gates
youtube.description:
What Steve Jobs really thought about Bill Gates: he thought Bill copied the Mac and never had any taste.

In 1983 he pulled Gates into a room and shouted theft. Gates answered with Xerox. In 1995 Jobs said Microsoft made third-rate products. Then he put that same man on a giant screen and took a hundred and fifty million dollars.

This illustrated documentary from What They Really Think tells that story.
